source_basis: The summary opens by naming who believes they already know, then states the quantitative goal.
interpretation: A consensus is staged so the measurement can replace it.
applicability: Any paper whose reader arrives with a strong prior.
counterevidence: Empty if the field has no such consensus.

source_basis: A failed classifier is called the inspiration for the next method.
interpretation: A negative result is kept and made to do rhetorical work.
applicability: Wherever a first attempt fails and a second is built on the failure.
counterevidence: Does not apply when the failure is incidental.

source_basis: The unmatched revolutions are offered as speculation about subtle change.
interpretation: A miss is hedged into a claim instead of dropped.
applicability: Closing paragraphs that must account for cases the record does not confirm.
counterevidence: The hedge collapses if the sentence is read as a result.

source_basis: The problem is posed as a question about scale, with both counts in the sentence.
interpretation: Size becomes the argument for needing a model.
applicability: Openings where the obstacle is the volume of the data.
counterevidence: Flat when the numbers are small.

source_basis: The structural facts are introduced with a phrase that promises immediate observations.
interpretation: Raw structure is delivered before any interpretation.
applicability: Right after a network or dataset is built.
counterevidence: Misuse if the observations are really conclusions.

source_basis: A whole family of metrics is dismissed with a sentence about major flaws.
interpretation: The field is cleared before the chosen measure appears.
applicability: Background sections choosing among standard metrics.
counterevidence: Unsupported if no replacement follows.

source_basis: A cited definition is kept and its one gap is named in the next clause.
interpretation: Credit and correction travel together.
applicability: When adopting a published measure with a known limit.
counterevidence: Unfair if the source does not have the gap.

source_basis: Each assumption is paired with a belief that justifies it.
interpretation: No assumption stands bare.
applicability: Assumption lists in any modelling paper.
counterevidence: The rationale can itself be indefensible.

source_basis: Equal weights are defended by calling every alternative subjective.
interpretation: A non-choice is turned into a stated principle.
applicability: Parameter sections where a natural weighting is tempting.
counterevidence: Does not prove the equal weights are right.

source_basis: A possible weighting is declined expressly for the sake of objectivity.
interpretation: Restraint is presented as method.
applicability: Wherever a refinement was available and skipped.
counterevidence: The claim of objectivity is stronger than the act.

source_basis: A list of defects is answered by the data cut that removes them.
interpretation: A restriction reads as a repair.
applicability: After a paragraph enumerating data problems.
counterevidence: Hollow if the cut does not fix the listed defects.

source_basis: One variable is excluded for the whole study and the next is kept by explicit contrast.
interpretation: Inclusion and exclusion are argued as a pair.
counterevidence: Breaks if the excluded variable returns later.

source_basis: The clustering result is interrupted by a question about whether it means anything.
interpretation: Validation is demanded in the open before it is supplied.
counterevidence: Rhetorical only if no answer follows.

source_basis: The accuracy is set against the rate expected from guessing.
interpretation: A percentage is given its baseline in the same sentence.
counterevidence: Misleading if the baseline is wrong.

source_basis: A section opens by granting that the reader already has opinions, then asks what defines them.
interpretation: The reader is disarmed before their terms are redefined.
counterevidence: Reads as flattery if no redefinition follows.

source_basis: Both target notions are called extremely elusive before either is defined.
interpretation: The definitions are flagged as constructed.
applicability: Before an operational definition of a vague idea.
counterevidence: Unnecessary when the notion is already sharp.

source_basis: A joke at a named figure is fenced off by a short aside.
interpretation: The register stays light without sneering.
applicability: A single aside in a results section.
counterevidence: Wears thin if repeated.

source_basis: Many types are conceded and only two are pursued.
interpretation: Scope is narrowed without pretending to be complete.
applicability: When a taxonomy is larger than what gets computed.
counterevidence: Dishonest if the count does not match the work.

source_basis: A metric is dropped because it means nothing over a short window.
interpretation: An exclusion carries its reason.
counterevidence: The reason must concern the setting.

source_basis: A weighting is refused because no quantitative test for it exists.
interpretation: Absence of a test is made the argument.
applicability: Where a refinement cannot be checked.
counterevidence: Does not apply when a test was available.

source_basis: An analysis is skipped and the lack of time is stated plainly.
interpretation: A gap is owned rather than hidden.
counterevidence: Becomes an excuse if overused.

source_basis: A match with the historical record is delivered with earned confidence.
interpretation: Confidence is signalled only after the prediction.
counterevidence: Unfair if the match was found by searching afterward.

source_basis: A discrepancy is given a guessed cause, marked as a guess.
interpretation: Speculation stays visibly separate from measurement.
counterevidence: Collapses if the next sentence treats it as fact.

source_basis: A cause absent from the data is credited while the absence is stated.
interpretation: An external cause stays external.
counterevidence: Misleading if the absence clause is cut.

source_basis: A parameter is called a balancing act with both extremes named.
interpretation: A tradeoff is framed instead of solved.
applicability: Sensitivity discussions of a single parameter.
counterevidence: Empty if one extreme is omitted.

source_basis: A substitution is admitted to rest mostly on how the results looked.
interpretation: An eyeballed constant is confessed.
counterevidence: Must not be reread as a derivation.

source_basis: The text says what a more robust model would do and stops there.
interpretation: An improvement is pointed at without being claimed.
counterevidence: Dishonest if the work was already done.

source_basis: A wish for better error analysis is blocked by the exploratory character of the question.
interpretation: The validation gap gets a cause.
applicability: Error sections on questions with no ground truth.
counterevidence: Cannot cover an error that was simply not checked.

source_basis: One gap is generalized into a property of the whole inquiry.
interpretation: The limitation is lifted from instance to kind.
counterevidence: Must not shelter a fixable mistake.

source_basis: The matching procedure is described and then called biased, with the direction implicit.
interpretation: The weakness names its own mechanism.
counterevidence: Incomplete unless the direction is recoverable.

source_basis: Two existing constructs are named and the missing third is asked about.
interpretation: The next question is derived from what is already built.
counterevidence: Fails if the third thing already exists.

source_basis: A prediction is made about a method not yet run.
interpretation: The expectation is committed to in advance.
counterevidence: Becomes a false claim if reported as done.

source_basis: An alternative definition is declined with a substantive because-clause.
interpretation: A closed door is given its reason.
counterevidence: Bare without the reason.

source_basis: The letter opens by picturing the addressee's own arguments.
interpretation: The reader is met inside their dispute.
applicability: Letters and memos to a named body.
counterevidence: Flattery if the picture is not accurate.

source_basis: An unsupervised step is described as pretending the labels did not exist.
interpretation: Method becomes a deliberate act of forgetting.
applicability: Explaining a label-free step to a lay reader.
counterevidence: Wrong if the labels were in fact used.

source_basis: The letter ends by bounding every claim to the data used.
interpretation: The closing move caps the scope.
counterevidence: Evasion if aimed at one specific flaw.

source_basis: Katz centrality adds a constant so artists with no followers still score.
interpretation: The leaf-node problem is handled inside the definition.
applicability: Centrality on networks with many sinks.
counterevidence: The constant later gets replaced by hand.

source_basis: Centrality is rescaled by years since the artist's decade.
interpretation: Time is meant to enter the ranking explicitly.
counterevidence: The printed exponential runs the wrong way.

source_basis: Genre entropy, previously defined for genres, is applied to single artists.
interpretation: A published measure is narrowed rather than replaced.
applicability: When a group statistic is needed at the member level.
counterevidence: The adaptation inherits the source's assumptions.

source_basis: Four distinct scores are stacked and reduced to one norm with equal weights.
interpretation: The ranking combines kinds of influence instead of choosing one.
counterevidence: Equal weights are themselves a choice.

source_basis: The groups are cut by k-means on the sonic variables with no genre label in the objective.
interpretation: The partition is genuinely unsupervised.
counterevidence: The cluster count was still tuned against the labels.

source_basis: Directed modularity scores how well a partition fits the influence edges.
interpretation: A partition gets a network-level number, not only a visual impression.
applicability: Comparing candidate partitions of one graph.
counterevidence: No null model accompanies the number.

source_basis: A revolution is defined as a centroid jump past a fixed threshold between decades.
interpretation: Change detection is reduced to one comparison.
applicability: Tracking a vector quantity over time windows.
counterevidence: The threshold is hand-set.

source_basis: Revolutionaries combine a centrality score with sonic similarity to the later centroid.
interpretation: Responsibility needs both influence and resemblance.
applicability: Attributing a detected change to individual nodes.
counterevidence: Neither factor is calibrated.

source_basis: The classifier's failure on the full label set is what motivates the clustering.
interpretation: The argument moves from a negative to a constructive step.
counterevidence: The failure could have other causes.

source_basis: The cluster count is chosen because it maximizes an index computed against the established genres.
interpretation: The tuning target is independent of the fitting objective.
counterevidence: The index then cannot also serve as unbiased confirmation.

source_basis: Revolutions are matched to dated historical events one by one.
interpretation: Each detected break is given an external anchor.
applicability: Validating a detector against a chronology.
counterevidence: The search runs from the result back to the record.

source_basis: The future-work question is derived by naming the two partitions in hand and asking for the third.
interpretation: The proposal follows from a visible gap.
counterevidence: The third partition may not be computable.

source_basis: Figure 3 shows two distinct regimes of the decay parameter.
interpretation: The plot is what justifies splitting influence into direct and indirect.
applicability: Choosing operating points of a parameter.
counterevidence: The regimes are read off by eye.

source_basis: Figure 5 peaks at three and four clusters and falls after that.
interpretation: The hyperparameter choice is visible in one scatter.
counterevidence: The peak is modest, near 0.16.

source_basis: Figure 7 marks revolutions as peaks in the centroid movement.
interpretation: The detector's output is the figure, not a table of decisions.
counterevidence: The peaks depend on the chosen threshold.

source_basis: The sonic genres are recoverable from the sonic variables at 52 percent against 25 percent chance.
interpretation: The partition is checked by a second method.
counterevidence: The check uses the same variables the clustering used.

source_basis: The adjusted Rand index of 0.161 quantifies the disagreement between the two partitions.
interpretation: Low agreement is reported as a number, not an impression.
applicability: Comparing two partitions of one set.
counterevidence: The value is small enough to be read either way.

source_basis: Key is dropped because pitch classes are not linearly ordered, and mode is kept.
interpretation: A variable is excluded for a structural reason, not a null result.
applicability: Feature selection with mixed variable types.
counterevidence: The excluded variable reappears in a later table.

source_basis: Fringe genres with a handful of artists force a restriction to the top five.
interpretation: A data cut is driven by a measured pathology.
counterevidence: The cut also serves computational convenience.

source_basis: The first decade is taken as the peak of influence.
interpretation: A timing assumption does the work of a measurement.
counterevidence: The paper gives only a belief in support.

source_basis: Indirect influence is assumed to accumulate geometrically.
interpretation: The functional form of the time scaling rests on this.
counterevidence: The prose says exponentially in the same section.

source_basis: Frank Ocean leads the 2000-2020 ranking by the norm of the vector.
interpretation: The combined measure names a single leader.
counterevidence: The per-component leaders are different names.

source_basis: Genre prediction from sound fails entirely until the label set is cut to four.
interpretation: Sound does not determine genre in general.
applicability: Testing whether labels match measured attributes.
counterevidence: The zero figure is implausible and may be a slip.

source_basis: Established genres are more modular than sonic genres, 0.38 against 0.17.
interpretation: The traditional labels fit the influence network better than the sound labels do.
counterevidence: No significance test is given.

source_basis: The largest mainstream movement falls in the 1930s.
interpretation: The detector returns a dated break.
counterevidence: Dependent on the hand-set threshold.

source_basis: The rhythm-and-blues revolution peaks near 1997.
interpretation: A single genre gets its own dated break.
counterevidence: The cause cited for it is absent from the data.

source_basis: Speechiness and duration score as the most contagious sonic variables.
interpretation: Some sound features pass from influencer to follower far more than others.
counterevidence: The metric may be measuring genre constancy rather than contagion.

source_basis: Equation (2) exponentiates the negated centrality, inverting the ranking the prose describes.
interpretation: The printed formula contradicts its own purpose.
applicability: Checking a rescaling against the claim made for it.
counterevidence: A sign convention could rescue it, but none is stated.

source_basis: The thresholds 3.0, 4.0 and 0.2 were picked to produce a few clear peaks.
interpretation: The revolutions are partly selected by the threshold.
applicability: Any detector with a hand-set cutoff.
counterevidence: The paper discloses this.

source_basis: The historical matching begins from a found revolution and looks for an explanation.
interpretation: The evaluation runs backwards and is biased.
counterevidence: The paper says so itself.

source_basis: Table 7 orders an artist at 0.47 ahead of one at 0.48.
interpretation: The ranking table contradicts the metric it reports.
applicability: Checking reported orderings against their values.
counterevidence: Could be a transcription slip in the source.

source_basis: Reference [1] denotes Bryan and Wang in the body and a different work in the summary footnote.
interpretation: The numbering system collides with itself.
counterevidence: The underlying sources are still identifiable.
